title: banana-content configuration
description: Configuration for @wikimedia/banana-content. Options that accept a function may instead be given a module specifier — a path to a module whose default export is that function, resolved relative to this config file.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema, for editor autocomplete and validation.

format.description: Format adapter: a built-in name, or a module specifier for a custom adapter.

anyOf.description: Module specifier for a custom adapter.

source.description: Where the source-language files are authored.

dir.description: Root of the source files, relative to this config file.

include.description: Globs relative to source.dir. Any line-oriented text format works; the extension does not have to be .md.

definitionsOnly.description: Globs for files that contribute message definitions but emit no output. Their definitions must use fully-qualified keys, since a path-derived namespace would be meaningless.

messages.description: Where message catalogues are written and read.

dir.description: Catalogue directory. The source and documentation catalogues here are GENERATED; every other <locale>.json is translator-owned and only ever read.

sourceLocale.description: The language source files are authored in. Always emitted, never subject to the translation threshold.

documentationLocale.description: Filename for the translator documentation catalogue (the qqq convention).

dir.description: Root the generated files are written under.

path.description: Output path template, or a module specifier for a function receiving (source, locale). Tokens: %locale%, %path% (source-relative path with extension), %dir%, %name% (basename without extension), %ext% (with dot).

overrides.description: Per-file path template overrides, keyed by path relative to source.dir. Same tokens as output.path.

list.description: Locales to generate. "auto" uses every <code>.json found in messages.dir.

fallback.description: Chain walked when a key is missing from a locale. A map of locale to ordered chain, or a module specifier for a function returning one. Defaults to [locale, sourceLocale].

minTranslatedPercent.description: Minimum share of a file's keys that must be translated before that locale is emitted for it. Below the threshold nothing is written, so host content fallback serves a clean single-language file instead of a mixed one. 0 emits everything.

prefix.description: Reserved key namespace. Also the test for whether a written key is a fully-qualified cross-file reference rather than a page-local one.

pattern.description: Regular expression (as a string, compiled with no flags) that every namespaced key must match. Change this to match if you change the prefix.

namespace.description: Module specifier for a function overriding how a local key becomes a full key. Defaults to deriving it from the source file's path.

marker.description: Marker names. Change only to resolve a collision with the host format: renaming after adoption is a breaking change to every source file in the project.

name.description: Directive name used by inline and block markers: :message[...] and ::message{...}.

definitionsBlock.description: Fence name for the definitions-only block: :::messages. Configured separately from marker.name rather than derived, because deriving it would require pluralisation.

ownership.description: How generated files are identified for wipe-and-recreate. Files are the UNION of the manifest and the in-file marker, so that a deleted manifest or a stripped marker each degrade safely.

manifest.description: Path to the generated-file manifest, or false to rely on the in-file marker alone.

marker.description: Metadata field stamped into generated files. Requires a format with an envelope; set to false otherwise.
